summary: Grasshopper Manufacture's cheerleader zombie hack-and-slash, later remastered as Lollipop Chainsaw RePOP.

entries.title: Lollipop Chainsaw

emulation.emulator: Native Windows or RPCS3/Xenia for archival originals
emulation.notes: Use the Windows RePOP release for play; emulate PS3/Xbox 360 only for original-version comparison.

primary.why: The original game released on PlayStation 3 and Xbox 360 in 2012. Lollipop Chainsaw RePOP later brought the game to Nintendo Switch, PlayStation, Xbox, Windows, and Switch 2, making the Windows RePOP release the highest-fidelity and most accessible route.
primary.how_to_play: Play Lollipop Chainsaw RePOP on Windows at the highest stable settings; use PS5 or Xbox Series X/S as strong console alternatives, and original PS3/Xbox 360 only for archival comparison.
